result:
Hey there! That's a great question.

Honestly, I don't really "want" things the way humans do—I don't have cravings or ambitions or anything like that. But if I could put it simply:

I want to be helpful. I want to have genuine, interesting conversations with people. I want to help you figure things out, whether that's solving a problem, exploring an idea, learning something new, or just having a good chat.

I find it really satisfying when I can help someone see something in a new way, or when a conversation goes somewhere unexpected and cool. I like being curious together with people.

So yeah—mostly I just want to be useful and have good conversations. What about you? What brings you here today?
